title: compare-golden.sh resolve_key interpolates the key into python -c source (injection-shaped; only hardcoded KEYS reach it today)
evidence:
python3 -c "
import json, sys
doc = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
v = doc
for part in '${1}'.split('.'):
    v = v[part]
" "$2"   ... called as: va="$(resolve_key "$k" "$a")" || { echo "  key $k missing in $a"; bad=1; continue; }
detail: The dotted key is spliced into Python source between single quotes; a key containing a quote or Python code would execute. Only hardcoded KEYS reach it today, so no live exploit path exists.
recommended_fix: Pass the key as an argv argument like the path (e.g. for part in sys.argv[2].split('.') ... invoked with "$2" "$1") — eliminating string interpolation into interpreter source.
